name: io.lexu/mcp
title: Lexu
description: Create AI images, video and music with your Lexu credits, with a spending limit per call.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The member's name, plan and this connection's permissions.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Credits available. This connection can spend up to the whole balance, as on the site.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Models with their inputs and the price in credits with default settings.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: How many credits a generation would cost. Charges nothing.

options.description: Model inputs other than the prompt, e.g. {"aspect_ratio":"9:16","duration":5}. See list_models.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Creates an image with Lexu and CHARGES the member's credits. Refused if the cost is above max_credits. Models: gpt-image-2.5 (best for text in images), gpt-image-2, nano-banana-2, seedream-5-pro, flux-2-max. Usually returns the result directly.

model.description: A image model id from list_models.

options.description: Model inputs other than the prompt, e.g. {"aspect_ratio":"9:16","duration":5}. See list_models.

reference_images.description: gpt-image-2, gpt-image-2.5 and seedream-5-pro only: photos of people or products to keep exactly as they are. Each is an https link, "generation:<id>" of an earlier Lexu image, or "upload:<id>" from create_upload_link. Same price.

max_credits.description: The most the member agreed to spend on this call (from estimate_cost).

wait_seconds.description: Wait this long for the result (default 45).

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Creates a video with Lexu and CHARGES the member's credits. Refused if the cost is above max_credits. Models: seedance-2-mini (cheapest), minimax-h3, wan-3, seedance-2, seedance-2.5, kling-3, veo-3.1-lite, veo-3.1-fast, veo-3.1. Returns an id right away; the result takes a few minutes (use get_generation).

model.description: A video model id from list_models.

options.description: Model inputs other than the prompt, e.g. {"aspect_ratio":"9:16","duration":5}. See list_models.

first_frame.description: Image to video: the picture the video starts from (seedance-2.5, seedance-2, seedance-2-fast, veo-3.1, veo-3.1-fast, veo-3.1-lite). An https link, "generation:<id>" of an earlier Lexu image, or "upload:<id>" from create_upload_link.

last_frame.description: The picture the video ends on (needs first_frame). Same forms as first_frame.

max_credits.description: The most the member agreed to spend on this call (from estimate_cost).

wait_seconds.description: Wait this long for the result (default 0).

tools.name: generate_music
tools.description: Creates music with Lexu and CHARGES the member's credits. Refused if the cost is above max_credits. Models: suno-v6. Returns an id right away; the result takes a few minutes (use get_generation).

model.description: A music model id from list_models.

prompt.description: Lyrics or a description of the song.

options.description: Model inputs other than the prompt, e.g. {"aspect_ratio":"9:16","duration":5}. See list_models.

max_credits.description: The most the member agreed to spend on this call (from estimate_cost).

wait_seconds.description: Wait this long for the result (default 0).

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: Status and output link of a generation. While running, can wait up to wait_seconds.

id.description: The id returned by a generate_* tool.

tools.name: list_studio_templates
tools.description: Ready-made Lexu studio templates that run several AI steps for one result: product ads from a product photo, talking photos, character sheets, outfit shoots, explainer videos, cinematic shots, photo fixes. Lists id, price in credits and whether the member's plan includes it. Use get_studio_template for the inputs.

tools.name: get_studio_template
tools.description: The inputs of one studio template (with the allowed option values) and its exact price for the options given. Charges nothing.

inputs.description: Options already chosen, to price them. Optional.

tools.name: run_studio_template
tools.description: Runs a studio template and CHARGES the member's credits (failed steps are refunded). Refused if the cost is above max_credits. Image inputs take an https link to a JPEG/PNG/WebP image, "generation:<id>" of an earlier Lexu result (from list_generations), or "upload:<id>" from create_upload_link for a photo on the member's device. Returns a job id; results take one to several minutes (use get_studio_job).

inputs.description: Input values by name, as listed by get_studio_template. Select inputs take one of the option values.

max_credits.description: The most the member agreed to spend on this run (the price from get_studio_template).

wait_seconds.description: Wait this long for the result (default 30).

tools.name: get_studio_job
tools.description: Progress and result links of a studio job. While running, can wait up to wait_seconds.

tools.name: create_upload_link
tools.description: Creates a one-hour link on lexu.io where the member uploads a photo or video from their device (for example a product photo). Give them upload_url; when they say it is done, pass use_as ("upload:<id>") as the image input of run_studio_template. Charges nothing.

kind.description: What the member will upload (default image).

tools.name: check_upload
tools.description: Whether the member has uploaded the file for an upload link: waiting, uploaded or expired.

tools.name: list_generations
tools.description: The member's recent generations, newest first.
